title: Hello World — My First Post
excerpt: Welcome to my blog! This is where I share thoughts, experiences, and things I find interesting.
content:
# Hello World — My First Post

Welcome to my blog! 🎉

This is my very first post. I built this website from scratch and I'm super excited to share things here.

## What to expect

- **Personal thoughts** — things on my mind
- **Travel stories** — adventures and places I've been
- **Hobbies** — stuff I enjoy doing

Stay tuned for more posts. Thanks for visiting!

title: Why I Built This Website
excerpt: A little backstory on why I decided to make my own corner of the internet.
content:
# Why I Built This Website

Everyone should have a little corner of the internet that's truly their own.

## The reason

I wanted a place to:

1. Share what I'm thinking
2. Document things I've learned
3. Have something to point people to

## What I used

Just plain **HTML**, **CSS**, and a little **JavaScript** — no fancy frameworks. Hosted for free on GitHub Pages.

> *"The best project is the one you actually finish."*

Hope you enjoy the site!
